problem: QNT returned HTTP 200 with an unavailable shell; public context cache and SEO snapshot were missing. Google reported a soft 404, not a noindex block.
data_repair: Refreshed QNT persisted SEO snapshot and prewarmed the canonical 365-day public ticker context. Existing metadata identifies Quantinuum on NASDAQ; 82 stored price rows and insider disclosures were present.
changes: Anonymous ticker readiness reads only persisted public snapshot/context; no provider rebuilds. If neither is usable, return non-cacheable HTTP 503 with Retry-After 60 before streaming.
Existing public snapshots remain readable with dated research copy when fresh context is unavailable.
Missing snapshots are not cached by the API; ticker snapshot reads do not retain missing results in the Next data cache.
No entitlement or ticker noindex rules changed.

validation.production_build: Passed Next.js compilation, type checks, and all 67 static pages.

limitation: Google indexing remains a separate Google decision; this release repairs the page response and data availability.
